nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $(u_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a sequence in $E$ and let $x \in E$. If $f(u_n) \to f(x)$ as $n \to \infty$ for every continuous linear functional $f \colon E \to \mathbb{K}$, then the norms are bounded above: there is a real number $C$ with $\|u_n\| \le C$ for all $n$.
nodes.title: Weakly convergent sequences are norm-bounded

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $(u_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a sequence in $E$ and let $x \in E$. If $u_n \to x$ in the weak topology of $E$ (the topology induced by all continuous linear functionals $E \to \mathbb{K}$), then there is a real number $C$ with $\|u_n\| \le C$ for all $n$.
nodes.title: Weakly convergent sequences are norm-bounded (weak topology form)

nodes.summary: In an infinite-dimensional normed space, the weak closure of the unit sphere is the closed unit ball.
nodes.title: Weak closure of the unit sphere is the closed unit ball

nodes.summary: Every nonempty weakly open set contains a whole line through each of its points: if `U` is weakly open and `x ∈ U`, then `x + t • v ∈ U` for all scalars `t` and some nonzero `v` (a common kernel vector of the finitely many functionals constraining a basic weak neighbourhood of `x`).
nodes.title: Weakly open sets contain lines through each point

nodes.summary: Finitely many continuous linear functionals on an infinite-dimensional normed space have a common nonzero kernel vector.
nodes.title: Finitely many functionals have a common nonzero kernel vector

nodes.summary: Every nonempty weakly open set in an infinite-dimensional normed space is unbounded in norm.
nodes.title: Weakly open sets are unbounded in infinite dimensions

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $(u_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a sequence in $E$ and let $x \in E$. If $u_n \to x$ in the weak topology of $E$ (the topology induced by all continuous linear functionals $E \to \mathbb{K}$), then $f(u_n) \to f(x)$ as $n \to \infty$ for every continuous linear functional $f \colon E \to \mathbb{K}$.
nodes.title: Weak convergence gives convergence under every functional

nodes.summary: In finite dimensions the identity map from the norm topology to the weak topology is an open map: the weak topology agrees with the norm topology.
nodes.title: Weak topology equals norm topology in finite dimensions

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $(u_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a sequence in $E$ and let $x \in E$. If $f(u_n) \to f(x)$ as $n \to \infty$ for every continuous linear functional $f \colon E \to \mathbb{K}$, that is, $u_n$ converges weakly to $x$, then $\|x\| \le \liminf_{n \to \infty} \|u_n\|$.
nodes.title: Weak lower semicontinuity of the norm

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $(u_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a sequence in $E$ and let $x \in E$. If $u_n \to x$ in the weak topology of $E$ (the topology induced by all continuous linear functionals $E \to \mathbb{K}$), then $\|x\| \le \liminf_{n \to \infty} \|u_n\|$.
nodes.title: Weak lower semicontinuity of the norm (weak topology form)

nodes.summary: The unit sphere is not weakly closed in infinite dimensions: its weak closure is the whole closed unit ball.
nodes.title: Unit sphere is not weakly closed in infinite dimensions

nodes.summary: The unit sphere is not weakly compact in infinite dimensions.
nodes.title: Unit sphere is not weakly compact in infinite dimensions

nodes.summary: The open unit ball is not weakly open in infinite dimensions.
nodes.title: Open unit ball is not weakly open in infinite dimensions

nodes.summary: The unit sphere is not weakly open in infinite dimensions.
nodes.title: Unit sphere is not weakly open in infinite dimensions

nodes.summary: In infinite dimensions the identity map from the norm topology to the weak topology is not an open map: the open unit ball is norm-open but not weakly open.
nodes.title: Weak topology is strictly coarser in infinite dimensions

nodes.summary: Let $E$ and $F$ be normed spaces over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $T \colon E \to F$ be a continuous linear map, let $(u_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a sequence in $E$ and let $x \in E$. If $f(u_n) \to f(x)$ for every continuous linear functional $f \colon E \to \mathbb{K}$, then $g(T u_n) \to g(T x)$ for every continuous linear functional $g \colon F \to \mathbb{K}$.
nodes.title: Bounded operators preserve weak convergence

nodes.summary: Let $E$ and $F$ be normed spaces over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $T \colon E \to F$ be a continuous linear map, let $(u_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a sequence in $E$ and let $x \in E$. If $u_n \to x$ in the weak topology of $E$, then $T u_n \to T x$ in the weak topology of $F$; here the weak topology of a space is the one induced by its continuous linear functionals.
nodes.title: Bounded operators preserve weak convergence (weak topology form)

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a normed space over $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $(u_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ be a sequence in $E$ and let $x \in E$. If $f(u_n) \to f(x)$ as $n \to \infty$ for every continuous linear functional $f \colon E \to \mathbb{K}$, then $u_n \to x$ in the weak topology of $E$ (the topology induced by all continuous linear functionals $E \to \mathbb{K}$).
nodes.title: Convergence under every functional gives weak convergence

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
